svg.aria-label: F01 — the fit that looks right: p/Z and the inventory it extrapolates to
svg.desc: Scatter plot of p/Z against cumulative gas produced for the base-case water-drive scenario, with the volumetric straight-line fit and its extrapolation to the x-axis. Forty-nine observed points run from 4344.2 psia at zero cumulative gas to 2203.2 psia at 55.0 Bscf, which is where observation stops. The fitted line crosses zero at 112.50 Bscf; the true gas in place is 100.0 Bscf, marked by a fine dotted vertical rule with a diamond. R-squared is 0.999859. Seven thin dotted traces behind show the other aquifer strengths. Full values in the data table below the figure.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: Base case, J = 2.0 bbl/day/psi. R-squared = 0.999859. The fitted line crosses zero at 112.50 Bscf against a true 100.0 Bscf, an error of +12.503%.
